user.title: Setup Hour Meter
user.description:
Set up the device operating hours tracking integration.

You can add multiple devices by adding this integration multiple times with different names.

data_description.name: A unique name for this device (e.g., 'House', 'Garden', 'Workshop').
data_description.binary_sensor_entity: Optional: An entity (binary_sensor, input_boolean, or switch) that monitors the device status.
data_description.invert: Enable if the entity shows inverted status (e.g., 0 = running, 1 = stopped).
data_description.latency_seconds: Delay before tracking stops after device turns off. Prevents stopping on brief interruptions.
data_description.merge_time_seconds: Time within which consecutive runs are merged.
data_description.adjust_paths: Enable to adjust the file paths individually in an additional step after clicking 'Next'. By default the paths are derived automatically from the device name (e.g. 'House' → /config/hour_meter/house-betriebsstunden.csv).

paths.title: Adjust paths
paths.description: Paths for device '{name}'. The suggested paths were derived from the name and can be adjusted if needed. The directory will be created automatically.

data_description.csv_path: Path to the CSV file that logs the operating hours.
data_description.startzeit_path: Path to the file that stores the start time.

error.startzeit_path_empty: Start time file path cannot be empty
error.csv_path_already_used: This CSV file is already used by another device
error.invalid_path: The path must be absolute and located inside the HA config directory

abort.already_configured: This device name is already configured.
